title: Todd and the Moon Behind the Reeds
synopsis: From the safe dry path at Reed Meadow, Todd finds that stepping beside a nearby reed can hide or reveal an almost-full Moon.
continuity_state: Before: The Moon appeared gibbous in Far Meadow several nights earlier. Todd lives in Reed Meadow with Aunt Pat and keeps two yellow boots, one with a blue patch. He knows Amy, Ben, Kim and Wendy. After: On an evening shortly before full Moon, Todd and Aunt Pat observe from the dry rise above the wet hollow; the near-full Moon is alternately occluded by a reed as Todd shifts position. He makes a paw curtain and returns home. Boots unchanged and paired by bed; no crossing of wet hollow, no new picture or book.
